title: Sports and Games
parentNote: This unit covers different sports, games, and famous players. Great for building sports awareness!
learnBullets: Learn about **popular sports** and their rules
Know about **sports equipment** used in different games
learnItFirst:
**1. Indoor vs Outdoor Games**

| Indoor Games 🏠 | Outdoor Games 🌳 |
|----------------|------------------|
| Chess | Cricket |
| Carrom | Football |
| Ludo | Hockey |
| Table Tennis | Kabaddi |

**2. Sports and Their Equipment**

| Sport | Equipment |
|-------|----------|
| Cricket 🏏 | Bat, ball, stumps |
| Football ⚽ | Football |
| Badminton 🏸 | Racket, shuttlecock |
| Tennis 🎾 | Racket, tennis ball |
| Hockey 🏑 | Stick, ball |

**3. Famous Indian Sports Players**

- **Sachin Tendulkar** — Cricket (God of Cricket)
- **Virat Kohli** — Cricket
- **P.V. Sindhu** — Badminton
- **Neeraj Chopra** — Javelin throw (Olympic gold)
- **Mary Kom** — Boxing

**4. Important Facts**

- **National sport of India**: Hockey
- **Most popular sport in India**: Cricket
- **Olympics**: Held every 4 years

questions.content: Which sport is played with a bat and ball?
questions.why: Cricket is played with a bat and ball

questions.content: Which is an indoor game?
questions.why: Chess is an indoor game played on a board

questions.content: Football is played with ___.
questions.why: Football is mainly played using feet (and sometimes head)

questions.content: How many players are there in a cricket team?
questions.why: A cricket team has 11 players

questions.content: Carrom is played on a ___.
questions.why: Carrom is an indoor game played on a carrom board

questions.content: Playing outdoor games keeps us ___.
questions.why: Playing outdoor games keeps our body healthy and fit

questions.content: Which sport uses a shuttlecock?
questions.why: Badminton is played with a racket and shuttlecock

questions.content: Which game do we play with dice?
questions.why: Ludo is played with dice and tokens on a board

questions.content: Hockey is played with a ___.
questions.why: Hockey is played with a hockey stick and ball

questions.content: Swimming is done in ___.
questions.why: Swimming is done in water — in a pool, river, or sea

questions.content: Sachin Tendulkar is famous for playing ___.
questions.why: Sachin Tendulkar is a legendary cricket player, called the 'God of Cricket'

questions.content: How many players are there in a football team?
questions.why: A football team has 11 players on the field

questions.content: What is India's national sport?
questions.why: Hockey is considered India's national sport

questions.content: Olympics are held every ___ years.
questions.why: The Olympic Games are held every 4 years

questions.content: P.V. Sindhu is a famous ___ player.
questions.why: P.V. Sindhu is an Olympic medal-winning badminton player from India

questions.content: Which sport is played on a court with a net in the middle?
questions.why: Badminton and tennis are played on courts with a net in the middle

questions.content: In chess, the most important piece is the ___.
questions.why: The King is the most important piece — if it's captured, the game is lost

questions.content: Neeraj Chopra won Olympic gold in ___.
questions.why: Neeraj Chopra won India's first Olympic gold in athletics (javelin throw)

questions.content: Kabaddi is an ___ game.
questions.why: Kabaddi is a traditional Indian sport played both indoors and outdoors

questions.content: Mary Kom is famous for ___.
questions.why: Mary Kom is a famous Indian boxer and Olympic medallist

questions.content: In cricket, the bowler tries to hit the ___.
questions.why: The bowler tries to hit the stumps (wickets) to get the batsman out

questions.content: A marathon is a ___ race.
questions.why: A marathon is a very long running race (about 42 kilometers)

questions.content: Which sport uses a goal post?
questions.why: Football is played with goal posts where players try to score goals

questions.content: The person who makes sure players follow the rules is called a ___.
questions.why: An umpire (cricket) or referee (football) ensures rules are followed

questions.content: Basketball is played by throwing the ball into a ___.
questions.why: Basketball players throw the ball into a basket (hoop) to score

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: Test your sports knowledge with these challenging questions!

questions.content: How many rings are there in the Olympic symbol?
questions.why: The Olympic symbol has 5 interlocking rings representing 5 continents

questions.content: Viswanathan Anand is famous for ___.
questions.why: Viswanathan Anand is a world-famous Indian chess grandmaster

questions.content: What colour is a cricket ball used in Test matches?
questions.why: A red ball is used in Test cricket; white ball is used in limited-overs cricket

questions.content: Wimbledon is a famous tournament for which sport?
questions.why: Wimbledon is one of the most famous tennis tournaments in the world

questions.content: FIFA World Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.why: FIFA World Cup is the biggest international football tournament
